title: getting-transformer-contract
description: The contract every getting-<noun> skill inherits: a pure read of state. The args MAY be empty (a request for the current observation of the named noun) or carry a query specifier (an addressing of which instance to fetch). The return shape is an object — the observation of the named noun. Per-noun shape constraints will be added when the structure-substitution mechanism is wired; for now the contract is loose on both ends.
